raw_articles.title: AWS Open Sources Kiro Crew for Asynchronous Coding Agents
raw_articles.summary: Amazon recently announced Kiro Crew, an open-source system for running multiple Kiro coding agents across sessions, tools, and tasks. The new workspace lets developers assign asynchronous coding tasks to AI agents, allowing work such as incident investigation, ticket triage, migrations, and PR monitoring to continue without active supervision. By Renato Losio

raw_articles.title: “We’re not doing 30 bets a year”: Vijay Pande on betting small after running $4 billion at a16z
raw_articles.summary: Vijay Pande — who left a16z's roughly $4 billion biotech practice last year to start the much smaller, AI-native VZVC — talks about why biology is finally shifting from a "discovery" science to an "engineering" one, why clinical trials are still brutally expensive, and why he thinks open, shared datasets (not walled-off ones) are what will actually let AI transform medicine.
